notes.title: v0.915 Patch
notes.notes:
Added visualization of lobby settings.
Added the ability to kick a lobby member. The lobby type now can be changed. 
Added filters in the search for servers. 
Added lobby name setting. 
Added blob sounds for the kick a player event.
Fixed a bug when duplicating existing inventory. 
Minor changes have been made to the store UI.
Minor map changes.

notes.title: Earthshaking Update
notes.notes: Added new ability "Earth shield". The ability will be temporarily free (enjoy ːcsgo_chickenː ). Added new effects for Fire ball, Laser fire place and The Gun. Bugs with UI, sounds and abilities have been fixed.

notes.title: Ambient update
notes.notes:
Added ambient sounds. 
Added overheat sounds. 
Added overchilling sounds. 
Added more fireball fragments and removed their collision with the player and between themselves.
Issues with sounds for some objects have been resolved.
Optimization issues have been fixed.

notes.title: Bug fixes update
notes.notes:
Added different blood levels of egg strength.
Added the ability for the laser to interact with the environment by its temperature.
Some bugs were fixed in robot with multiplayer and display of abilities, effects with sounds for other players. 
Fixed a bug where the overall volume was set to 0 at startup.
Minor changes to the UI.
